application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Redevelopment of the building to provide three flats with associated rear garden, cycle parking and waste storage, including residential conversion of the ground floor Chauffer Booking Office and the erection of a single storey rear extension and rear roof extension.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (20/464/04 (Rev D); 20/464/05 (Rev C); 20/464/07 (Rev B)  Received:  15 December 2020; 20/464/01 (Rev C); 20/464/08 (Rev A)  Received:  11 December 2020; 20/464/02; 20/464/03; Unreferenced Location Plan  Received:  26 October 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Prior to the first occupation of the development, the replacement ground floor front elevation hereby approved shall be installed with a cream painted pebbledash rendered wall, white painted replacement standard timber fascia, double glazed white UPVC bow window and white UPVC front door.  
The single storey rear extension hereby approved shall be constructed with matching red bricks and have white double glazed windows/ doors and an appropriate flat roofing material.  The approved ground floor rear window shall be white UPVC framed and double glazed.  
The two rear roof dormer extensions hereby approved shall have double glazed white UPVC windows and be clad with matching roof tiles only.  
All new and replacement guttering and drainpipes shall be matching black UPVC.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the first occupation of the development, an appropriate cycle storage unit/ outbuilding comprising three lockable compartments, to provide two single level cycle parking spaces in a Sheffield stand format for each flat designed in accordance with the WestTRANS Cycle Design Guidance, shall be implemented and permanently retained as such.  
Prior to the first occupation of the development, a secure rear gate to the cycle storage area, with an appropriate communal locking system, and a permeable hard surface treatment providing adequate drainage for the cycle storage area, shall be implemented and permanently retained as such.

Condition : 5 - The internal waste/ recycling stores associated with each of the three flats hereby approved shall be provided and permanently retained for this purpose.  All waste and recyclable materials for each flat shall be stored in its designated waste/recycling store only, which shall be ventilated as described by the approved drawings.  
Residual waste bags and official LB Hounslow recycling and food waste bins, with which each flat shall be provided as set out on the Council's website https://www.hounslow.gov.uk/info/20128/, shall be placed on the public footway directly in front of the building only for collection no earlier than 12 hours before the regular local collection time.  Emptied bins and any uncollected waste shall be fully removed from the public highway on the same day as this collection time.  
No waste, recyclable materials or bins related to the property shall be stored on the public footway at any other time, or on the public carriageway, in the communal rear cycle parking area or on the private rear access road under any circumstance.
Condition : 6 - Prior to the first occupation of the development, hard and soft landscaping for the rear garden hereby approved shall be implemented.

Condition : 7 - Prior to the occupation at the site, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority describing the means by which future residents of this development shall be excluded from the Local Car Parking Permit Scheme. The development shall only be carried out and occupied in accordance with that approved scheme.

Condition : 8 - Prior to the completion of redevelopment works, all existing satellite dishes, rear defunct plant including an air conditioning unit and flue, lighting and wiring shall be removed from the building, and the existing single storey rear outrigger, rear external staircase and first floor rear balcony canopy structure shall be demolished.  All waste shall be promptly removed from the site.  
No replacement satellite dishes shall be attached to the front elevation of the building without obtaining planning permission from the Local Planning Authority.  
Prior to the first occupation of the development, the building's first floor front wall shall  be repainted cream to match the replacement ground floor front elevation hereby approved, and any necessary replacement of existing windows with matching white UPVC double glazed windows or repairs to/ maintenance of the existing roof with matching roof tiles shall be undertaken to ensure that the building does not experience damp, water ingress, wind drafts and is generally retained in a good and attractive condition fit for residents' habitation.  
Prior to the first occupation of the development, details of the first floor rear balcony's refurbishment, including the installation of a replacement matching red brick rear and appropriate concrete or stone paved floor with drainage to prevent flooding, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, implemented and permanently retained as such.
